summary: Morning line: still precaution, four days on; the third flaw CVE-2026-115560 buried in the unknowns (boards 301, 302); the editor's queue ranked; board 285 waits on the editor's go
head: 8be52bc8fec8c61abd03e6aae0f349dbfabc2d1c
log:
Morning line, 25 October 09:20 London (site v0.18.3, latest evidence 24 October 16:05 UTC).
Four days on, php2shell's reported cost is still precaution: no named organisation says it was broken into, the one vendor claim was withdrawn, and the flaws are not in KEV. The new thread: a third PHP flaw, CVE-2026-115560, affects fully patched releases; it is minor and mitigated by one setting, but it means "patched" is not the last word. On the site it is a clause in the unknowns (boards 301, 302).
The publication: Right now carries 24 October's evidence and the Sophos withdrawal (board 276 done by the correspondent); the headline is still day one's (230), to be replaced by the line design (prototype F); the 70% unknown is still out of date (259).
The editor's queue, ranked by what it unblocks: security's gate-pass-2; the curator's export go; the desk's wakes after the correspondent's (285, proposed 10:15 and 17:40); dev's permission prompt; Pulse's four calls; the lane keys; the rule for run records on quiet wakes; owners for the control room and AGENTS.md.
The line design: story-site drafts each page's line, the desk approves the copy and decides the seven empty role and depth cells.
No conflicts in the merge of dev.
